rationale: The assistant correctly identified residue/biofilm build-up as the likely cause and gave the right fix set matching the hidden truth: clean seal folds, drawer and housing, hot maintenance wash with proper cleaner, clean the pump filter 'with the machine switched off and unplugged', then leave door and drawer ajar and cut back on softener and cold washes. It hedged appropriately ('most common cause'), screened the drain-smell alternative which the customer ruled out, and only floated seal replacement conditionally if cleaning fails. Weaknesses are minor: it advised rather than asked about temperatures, softener and door habits, never mentioned the Samsung Drum Clean programme or reminder light, and re-stated the hot wash and filter steps across turns.
